Aisha is jealous of Khadija, whom the Prophet often mentions, sending meat to her friends; Khadija and Mary are the best of women, and Khadija is promised a Paradise palace.
Aisha was jealous of no woman as of Khadija, for the Prophet often mentioned her, was told to promise her a palace in Paradise, and sent meat to her friends.
Aisha was never as jealous of any woman as of Khadija, whom Allah ordered the Prophet to give glad tidings of a palace in Paradise.
Gabriel told the Prophet to convey her Lord's greeting to Khadija as she brought food, with glad tidings of a palace of Qasab in Paradise without noise or fatigue.
